steps.name: exercise solution (future execution only)

steps.name: archive database (future execution only)
steps.cmd: docker compose -p {project} exec -T db pg_dump -U learner -d code101 -Fc -f /tmp/code101.dump

steps.name: create empty restore target
steps.cmd: docker compose -p {project} exec -T db createdb -U learner --template=template0 code101_restored

steps.name: restore saved archive
steps.cmd: docker compose -p {project} exec -T db pg_restore --exit-on-error --no-owner -U learner -d code101_restored /tmp/roundtrip.dump

steps.name: restored rows and policy
steps.cmd: docker compose -p {project} exec -T db psql -X -q -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U learner -d code101_restored -f /scripts/restore_check.sql
